name: A Trail of Petals counts a butterfly once its rescuer reaches Eldya, wherever the butterfly is (#6179, #6386, #7113)
contract: Reports #6179, #6386 and #7113: butterflies freed in A Trail of Petals (1660017) follow the hero but are not counted at Eldya (161848) on the guard tower; they lag behind or cannot path up the stairs.

Quest data: objective 0 is [KC] Newborns saved (161846) x3, objective 1 is Butterfly (161847) x3. The butterfly SmartAI follows its summoner and credits 161847 when it is within INTERACTION_DISTANCE (5.5 yd) of Eldya, then hides after 5 s and despawns 5 s later.

Decided expectation: a delivery counts as soon as the summoner is within INTERACTION_DISTANCE of Eldya, regardless of where the butterfly is. The credit, its once-per-butterfly limit and the despawn stay as they were.

Fixture: the open Northshire ground of pyromancer-flame-step-dash-movement (map 0) so the butterfly can path, Eldya 35 yd away along +X, so the butterfly (run speed 8 yd/s) needs well over 2.5 s of game time to reach her. Before the fix the delivery assertion times out; after it the summoner check runs every second.
The harness cannot reproduce the guard tower stairs; it checks the decided rule, not the original pathing.

steps.label: Fixture: Communion Banquet objectives are done
Place a Baby Night Elf in front of the hero
The rescue summons the hero's butterfly
The butterfly follows the hero away from Eldya
Control: no butterfly is delivered away from Eldya
Move the hero next to Eldya
The butterfly is still far behind the hero
The butterfly is delivered while its rescuer stands at Eldya
Give the follow arrival check time to fire again
